items.title: Cobalt‐Catalyzed [2σ+2π] Cycloaddition via Site‐Selective Capture of Bicyclobutane Diradical
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Strained bicyclo[1.1.0]butanes (BCBs) have emerged as versatile precursors for accessing highly reactive intermediates, enabling unconventional bond constructions through strain‐release pathways. Herein, we report a cobalt(II)‐catalyzed strategy that combines thermal activation of BCBs with selective radical capture by Co(II) to afford head‐to‐head fused bicyclo[2.1.1]hexanes (BCHex). We propose that thermal activation of the BCB generates a reactive diradical intermediate, which is intercepted by a tailored bidentate phosphine Co(II) cationic complex via oxidative radical coupling, followed by a [2σ+2π] cycloaddition with indoles. Mechanistic investigations, including 31 P NMR spectroscopy, cyclic voltammetry, electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), and density functional theory (DFT) studies, provide insights into the plausible reaction pathway. The involvement of paramagnetic Co(II) species is consistent with the broad features observed in both EPR and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra of the catalyst. In addition, four structurally distinct Co(II) complexes were synthesized, fully characterized by UV–Vis and Fourier‐transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, and evaluated as catalysts for the transformation. The cationic nature of the Co(II) species was further confirmed by phosphine oxide trapping experiments and single‐crystal X‐ray crystallography.
items.reason: Co(II)催化BCB与吲哚[2σ+2π]环加成显然是潜在有机合成方法，但fresh compact与Wiley官方摘要均未陈述底物多样性、产物范围或分离收率，不能据题名和单一反应概述确认一般性。
items.evidenceBasis: Wiley官方摘要确认热活化BCB、Co(II)选择性捕获及与吲哚形成头对头稠合bicyclo[2.1.1]hexane；同时列出大量机理表征和四种Co配合物，却未提供底物/产物范围事实。
items.challengeReason: 首遍已确认这是真实催化环加成，但因摘要没有底物/产物范围而标为pending；第二遍用Wiley官方摘要复核后，仍只能确认反应与催化机理，无法证明充分一般性，故继续pending而不推定范围。
items.evidenceNeeded: 正文或SI中的BCB与吲哚底物范围、分离产物及收率，确认方法不是单一模型反应。
items.nextAction: 通过现有Tampermonkey/VPN Bridge读取Wiley正文或SI底物范围；不从摘要中的“strategy”推断一般性。
items.firstPassRationale: 首遍已识别为真实环加成，但官方摘要未给出底物/产物范围或分离收率；按边界证据门槛首遍即暂缓，而非仅凭反应名称纳入。

items.title: Electrocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Reduction Coupled with Alcohol Oxidation
topics: Renewable Energy, Sustainability and the Environment
items.reason: 题名只确认CO₂电还原与醇氧化耦合；仍无法判定主要贡献是能源电催化还是具有充分醇底物/产物范围的一般电有机合成。
items.evidenceBasis: fresh compact摘要继续为空；出版社DOI与PDF页面未取得，仍缺醇底物、氧化产物、范围、分离收率与主要贡献事实。该证据缺口自2026-09-22保留，未因超出窗口删除。
items.challengeReason: 不能因能源主题直接排除，因为配对阳极醇氧化可能包含可推广有机制备；也不能凭题名中的alcohol oxidation纳入。两遍均确认需出版社摘要、正文或SI。
items.evidenceNeeded: 出版社摘要或正文/SI中醇底物类别、氧化产物、底物范围、分离收率，以及主要评价是否为合成产物还是CO₂还原/能效。
